submarines.rule: Do not recall WIO boats merely to inflate Santo count.

ground.assault_nucleus: South Seas Detachment: 2-3 infantry battalion equivalents plus organic guns/support; do not assume zero PM casualties.
ground.engineers: 15th Independent Engineer Regiment elements; RI/Buna requirement disappears in Branch after PM fall.
ground.contingency_reserve: Yazawa/17th-Army FS battalion-equivalent pool; activate if Allied major reinforcement to Santo is confirmed.
ground.PM_relief: Aoba Detachment is assigned to PM relief/security role and is not counted in Santo assault headcount.
ground.NC_reserve: Kawaguchi main body remains a follow-on New Caledonia reserve; do not double-count in Santo.

transports.note: RI/Buna and superseded full-FS shipping demand is released; first-day lift benefits from accepted amphibious cargo/process improvements but no magical hull capacity is added.

nodes.Rabaul: regional heavy logistics / repair / fuel / air-seaplane hub
nodes.Kavieng: regional support hub; lighter than Rabaul
nodes.Port Moresby: Branch-held land-air ISR/staging hub; not a substitute for Rabaul heavy naval logistics
nodes.Tulagi-Gavutu: usable but limited forward seaplane/anchorage node
nodes.Buka Passage: construction/anchorage node; not a mature fighter base
nodes.Lunga: airfield under construction; ISR/liaison/emergency utility only at cut date, not a mature combat airbase
